title: How to make action cards in 3 minutes | ELUM
description: No drawing or laminating needed. The easiest way to make action cards from one line of text, plus five tips for making good cards.
keywords: how to make action cards, make a visual schedule, picture schedule maker, visual schedule app, routine cards for kids, printable routine cards, action card app
heading: How to make action cards the easy way
lede: Finding pictures, printing and laminating turns into writing one line.

sections.heading: What happens when you make them by hand
paragraphs: Even when you know action cards are useful, making them is a chore. Choosing pictures, fitting the size, printing and cutting can take an hour for one routine. When the routine changes, you start over.
Cards need to be easy to make so you can keep using them.

sections.heading: The steps in ELUM
list: Write one line. Write it the way you'd normally say it, like "wash face and get dressed in the morning"
The cards are made. ELUM breaks it into easy steps and adds a picture and a short sentence to each
The caregiver checks them. Edit the sentences, change the order, and add or remove cards
Choose a reward. Write down what your child gets when everything is done
Save, and that's it. The cards appear one at a time on your child's screen and are read aloud

sections.heading: Tips for making good cards
list: One action only. If a card has "and" in it, split it into two
Words you can see. "Rub the backs of your hands" instead of "wash well"
Say what to do. "Walk" instead of "don't run"
Keep the same picture. The same picture for the same action is easier to recognize
Start with 3 to 5 cards. Add more little by little when it goes well

sections.heading: You can use paper cards too
paragraphs: In places where a device is hard to use, paper is handy. You can export the cards you make in ELUM for printing and cut them out.

faq.q: Can I use AI-made cards as they are?
faq.a: Please read them first and edit them. ELUM shows only the cards a caregiver has checked and saved.

faq.q: Can I make them for free?
faq.a: Yes. You can make cards with Emoji pictures and Picture symbols for free.
